units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|As you pass through the spaceport you notice a crowd of trilling Hai clustered in one area.|119|0
units.english: As you pass through the spaceport you notice a crowd of trilling Hai clustered in one area.
units.italian: Mentre attraversate lo spazioporto, notate una folla di Hai che trillano raccolti in una zona.

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	(Ignore them and pass by.)|121|0
units.english: (Ignore them and pass by.)
units.italian: (Ignorateli e passate oltre.)

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	(Take a look.)|123|0
units.english: (Take a look.)
units.italian: (Date un'occhiata.)

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	The crowd appears to be mostly made up of younger Hai, though a few more mature Hai are also there, visibly exhibiting more restraint on their enthusiasm. Reaching the edge of the crowd and peering over the shorter Hai folk, you can see a table set up with two standing banners flanking it and a stack of, at a glance, glossy printed photos.|124|0
units.english: The crowd appears to be mostly made up of younger Hai, though a few more mature Hai are also there, visibly exhibiting more restraint on their enthusiasm. Reaching the edge of the crowd and peering over the shorter Hai folk, you can see a table set up with two standing banners flanking it and a stack of, at a glance, glossy printed photos.
units.italian: La folla sembra composta per lo più da Hai giovani, anche se ci sono alcuni Hai più maturi, che mostrano visibilmente più ritegno nel loro entusiasmo. Raggiunto il bordo della folla e guardando al di sopra degli Hai più bassi, vedete un tavolo allestito con due stendardi ai lati e una pila di quelle che, a prima vista, sono foto stampate su carta patinata.

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	The banners depict a rather buff looking Hai, rendered in great detail, with a holographically enhanced animation that makes it appear to be continuously going through the motion of lifting and dropping a generically blurred opponent. The effect is, though, achieved solely through a trick of artificially shifting perspective. To your surprise you realize that this is a signing event for a wrestling star, of all things.|125|0
units.english: The banners depict a rather buff looking Hai, rendered in great detail, with a holographically enhanced animation that makes it appear to be continuously going through the motion of lifting and dropping a generically blurred opponent. The effect is, though, achieved solely through a trick of artificially shifting perspective. To your surprise you realize that this is a signing event for a wrestling star, of all things.
units.italian: Gli stendardi raffigurano un Hai dall'aria piuttosto muscolosa, reso con grande dettaglio, con un'animazione potenziata in ologramma che lo fa sembrare intento senza posa a sollevare e lasciar cadere un avversario volutamente sfocato. L'effetto, però, è ottenuto solo con un trucco di prospettiva spostata artificialmente. Con vostra sorpresa, capite che si tratta di una sessione di autografi di una stella del wrestling, nientedimeno.

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	After only a moment the individual in question emerges from a booth behind the setup and greets their fans, who prove very enthusiastic, before sitting down with some kind of pen for the assembled Hai to line up. It would seem that certain human customs have become popularized among the Hai.|126|0
units.english: After only a moment the individual in question emerges from a booth behind the setup and greets their fans, who prove very enthusiastic, before sitting down with some kind of pen for the assembled Hai to line up. It would seem that certain human customs have become popularized among the Hai.
units.italian: Dopo solo un momento la persona in questione esce da una cabina dietro l'allestimento e saluta i suoi fan, che si dimostrano molto entusiasti, prima di sedersi con una specie di penna per la fila degli Hai radunati. Sembra che certe usanze umane si siano diffuse fra gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Wrestling Star|	You can hear the Hai crowd trilling for some distance as you go about your business.|128|0
units.english: You can hear the Hai crowd trilling for some distance as you go about your business.
units.italian: Potete sentire la folla di Hai trillare per un bel tratto mentre proseguite per i vostri affari.

units.id: mission:Fencing Star|	The banners depict a svelte Hai in the strikingly familiar costume of a fencer, with a holographically enhanced animation that makes it appear to be continuously performing an elegant parry and riposte against an out-of-frame opponent. The effect is, though, achieved solely through a trick of artificially shifting perspective. To your surprise you realize that this is a signing event for a fencing star, of all things.|148|0

The effect is, though, achieved solely through a trick of artificially shifting perspective. To your surprise you realize that this is a signing event for a fencing star, of all things.
units.italian: Gli stendardi raffigurano un Hai snello nella divisa di schermidore, di una familiarità sorprendente, con un'animazione potenziata in ologramma che lo fa sembrare intento senza posa a eseguire un'elegante parata e risposta contro un avversario fuori campo. L'effetto, però, è ottenuto solo con un trucco di prospettiva spostata artificialmente. Con vostra sorpresa, capite che si tratta di una sessione di autografi di una stella della scherma, nientedimeno.

units.id: mission:Mystery Sport Star|	The banners depict a pair of Hai, one with a net and one with what looks like a bladed frisbee. It's not at all clear what precisely it is that they do, and when the individuals in question emerge from a booth behind the setup and greet their fans it becomes clear that, if you could even make yourself heard over the trilling, no one is particularly keen to explain it to you.|171|0
units.english: The banners depict a pair of Hai, one with a net and one with what looks like a bladed frisbee. It's not at all clear what precisely it is that they do, and when the individuals in question emerge from a booth behind the setup and greet their fans it becomes clear that, if you could even make yourself heard over the trilling, no one is particularly keen to explain it to you.
units.italian: Gli stendardi raffigurano una coppia di Hai, uno con una rete e uno con quella che sembra una sorta di frisbee con lame. Non è affatto chiaro che cosa facciano esattamente, e quando le persone in questione escono da una cabina dietro l'allestimento e salutano i fan diventa evidente che, anche riuscendo a farvi sentire sopra il trillare, nessuno ha particolare voglia di spiegarvelo.

units.id: mission:Mystery Sport Star|	The pair remove their helmets and flash dazzling Hai smiles at their fans before sitting down with some kind of pen for the assembled Hai to line up. It would seem that celebrity signings are popular among the Hai.|172|0
units.english: The pair remove their helmets and flash dazzling Hai smiles at their fans before sitting down with some kind of pen for the assembled Hai to line up. It would seem that celebrity signings are popular among the Hai.
units.italian: I due si tolgono i caschi e rivolgono ai fan sorrisi smaglianti alla maniera Hai, prima di sedersi con una specie di penna per la fila degli Hai radunati. Sembra che le sessioni di autografi delle celebrità siano popolari fra gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|You stop at a diner for a meal ground-side at the spaceport, but you have not been seated long before you notice there is a group of other human ship captains sequestered in a corner playing, near as you can tell, a game of poker. You note that the group seems to be getting a variety of dark looks from various Hai also dining at the establishment.|188|0
units.english: You stop at a diner for a meal ground-side at the spaceport, but you have not been seated long before you notice there is a group of other human ship captains sequestered in a corner playing, near as you can tell, a game of poker. You note that the group seems to be getting a variety of dark looks from various Hai also dining at the establishment.
units.italian: Vi fermate in una tavola calda per mangiare a terra nello spazioporto, ma non siete seduti da molto quando notate un gruppo di altri capitani di navi umani appartati in un angolo che giocano, per quanto riuscite a capire, a poker. Notate che il gruppo riceve una varietà di sguardi torvi da vari Hai che stanno cenando nel locale.

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	After a short while the barkeep, a middling and slightly overweight Hai, comes over to take your order.|189|0
units.english: After a short while the barkeep, a middling and slightly overweight Hai, comes over to take your order.
units.italian: Dopo un po' arriva a prendere l'ordine il barista, un Hai di mezza età e leggermente in sovrappeso.

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	(Place an order.)|191|0
units.english: (Place an order.)
units.italian: (Ordinate qualcosa.)

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Hey, I noticed there are some dark looks around here. Are human captains not welcome?"|193|0
units.english: "Hey, I noticed there are some dark looks around here. Are human captains not welcome?"
units.italian: "Ehi, ho notato che ci sono degli sguardi torvi qui intorno. I capitani umani non sono benvenuti?"

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	The barkeep looks confused for a second before looking over at the table and shaking his head in understanding. "Oh no, you're perfectly welcome. That group is just breaking the maturity tenets, and some Hai get uncomfortable with adults blatantly acting like children in public."|194|0
units.english: The barkeep looks confused for a second before looking over at the table and shaking his head in understanding. "Oh no, you're perfectly welcome. That group is just breaking the maturity tenets, and some Hai get uncomfortable with adults blatantly acting like children in public."
units.italian: Il barista sembra confuso per un istante, poi guarda verso il tavolo e scuote la testa, avendo capito. "Oh no, siete perfettamente benvenuti. Quel gruppo sta semplicemente infrangendo i principi della maturità, e alcuni Hai si sentono a disagio quando degli adulti si comportano sfacciatamente come bambini in pubblico."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	(Place an order.)|196|0
units.english: (Place an order.)
units.italian: (Ordinate qualcosa.)

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"The maturity tenets?"|198|0
units.english: "The maturity tenets?"
units.italian: "I principi della maturità?"

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Oh right, I suppose you wouldn't know. There are a number of tenets that Hai are taught growing up, lessons to be internalized to be a responsible and functioning member of society. The second is 'To be honest in dealings,' and the third is 'To gamble only on skill, not chance,' so their game breaks two of them."|199|0
units.english: "Oh right, I suppose you wouldn't know. There are a number of tenets that Hai are taught growing up, lessons to be internalized to be a responsible and functioning member of society. The second is 'To be honest in dealings,' and the third is 'To gamble only on skill, not chance,' so their game breaks two of them."
units.italian: "Ah già, suppongo che lei non lo sappia. Ci sono diversi principi che agli Hai vengono insegnati crescendo, lezioni da interiorizzare per essere un membro responsabile e funzionante della società. Il secondo è 'Essere onesti negli affari', e il terzo è 'Scommettere solo sull'abilità, non sul caso', quindi il loro gioco ne infrange due."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Some would say poker is more about skill than chance."|201|0
units.english: "Some would say poker is more about skill than chance."
units.italian: "Alcuni direbbero che il poker è più questione di abilità che di caso."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Surely if it's just a game though, there's no harm in it?"|202|0
units.english: "Surely if it's just a game though, there's no harm in it?"
units.italian: "Certo, però se è solo un gioco, non c'è niente di male, no?"

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Oh no, I'm afraid the first tenet ensures that it's really not favorable either way. The first is 'To have clear separation of fantasy and reality,' so a game cannot have real consequences or it is reality, not fantasy. So to gamble money on the game is to bring real consequences to a fantasy exercise. This is taboo for an adult.|203|0
units.english: "Oh no, I'm afraid the first tenet ensures that it's really not favorable either way. The first is 'To have clear separation of fantasy and reality,' so a game cannot have real consequences or it is reality, not fantasy. So to gamble money on the game is to bring real consequences to a fantasy exercise. This is taboo for an adult.
units.italian: "Oh no, temo che il primo principio garantisca che non sia davvero favorevole in nessuno dei due casi. Il primo è 'Avere una chiara separazione fra fantasia e realtà', così un gioco non può avere conseguenze reali, altrimenti è realtà, non fantasia. Quindi scommettere denaro sul gioco significa portare conseguenze reali in un esercizio di fantasia. Questo è tabù per un adulto.

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"If you interpret the game as being played for the skill, without the wagering, then you clear the first and third tenet, but you have the issue that the principle skills are bluffing and manipulation, which violates the second tenet. Bluffing isn't a skill seen as having virtue, nor is manipulation."|204|0
units.english: "If you interpret the game as being played for the skill, without the wagering, then you clear the first and third tenet, but you have the issue that the principle skills are bluffing and manipulation, which violates the second tenet. Bluffing isn't a skill seen as having virtue, nor is manipulation."
units.italian: "Se si interpreta il gioco come giocato per l'abilità, senza le puntate, allora si soddisfano il primo e il terzo principio, ma resta il problema che le abilità principali sono il bluff e la manipolazione, il che viola il secondo principio. Il bluff non è un'abilità considerata virtuosa, e nemmeno la manipolazione."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	"Wait, do the Hai not lie or bluff?"|206|0
units.english: "Wait, do the Hai not lie or bluff?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, gli Hai non mentono e non bluffano?"

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	The barkeep chortles with a strange trill and says, "Oh no, the Hai do lie and bluff. We're actually very good at bluffing, evolutionarily advantageous in the wild and all that. It's just seen as very immature and base. An adult should be able to conduct their life without resorting to such primitive instincts. We learned that the hard way long ago, back before we holed up in our current borders."|207|0
units.english: The barkeep chortles with a strange trill and says, "Oh no, the Hai do lie and bluff. We're actually very good at bluffing, evolutionarily advantageous in the wild and all that. It's just seen as very immature and base. An adult should be able to conduct their life without resorting to such primitive instincts. We learned that the hard way long ago, back before we holed up in our current borders."
units.italian: Il barista ridacchia con uno strano trillo e dice: "Oh no, gli Hai mentono e bluffano. Siamo anzi molto bravi a bluffare, vantaggioso per l'evoluzione allo stato brado e cose così. È solo considerato molto immaturo e basso. Un adulto dovrebbe poter condurre la propria vita senza ricorrere a istinti così primitivi. L'abbiamo imparato a nostre spese molto tempo fa, prima di rinchiuderci nei nostri confini attuali."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	He looks at you intently before continuing, "You won't hear the tenets brought up very much, but if you look closely you'll see that the first three especially are ingrained in our society very deeply."|208|0
units.english: He looks at you intently before continuing, "You won't hear the tenets brought up very much, but if you look closely you'll see that the first three especially are ingrained in our society very deeply."
units.italian: Vi guarda intensamente prima di continuare: "Non sentirete parlare spesso dei principi, ma se guardate bene vedrete che i primi tre soprattutto sono radicati molto in profondità nella nostra società."

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	With a shrug he flips open his order pad and pats his belly. "Of course, my gran always said that any of them after the tenth were more guidelines than actual rules, and I certainly have my share of disagreements with thirteen. Now, before I talk your ears off, what'll I get for you?"|209|0
units.english: With a shrug he flips open his order pad and pats his belly. "Of course, my gran always said that any of them after the tenth were more guidelines than actual rules, and I certainly have my share of disagreements with thirteen. Now, before I talk your ears off, what'll I get for you?"
units.italian: Con un'alzata di spalle apre il blocchetto degli ordini e si dà un colpetto sulla pancia. "Certo, mia nonna diceva sempre che quelli dopo il decimo erano più indicazioni che regole vere, e di certo ho le mie divergenze con il tredicesimo. Ora, prima di parlarle fino a stordirla, che cosa le porto?"

units.id: mission:Gambling Judgment|	He takes your order diligently and with a smile.|211|0
units.english: He takes your order diligently and with a smile.
units.italian: Prende l'ordine con diligenza e con un sorriso.
